name: Video embed
summary: A video poster with a play button that loads the player only when pressed.
description:
Use it for YouTube, Vimeo or self-hosted videos on marketing and help pages. A player embedded straight away loads megabytes of script and sets cookies before anyone presses play; this loads nothing from the video site until the click.

The poster is a link to the video, so without JS it simply opens it. data-v-video holds the player URL: an embed URL becomes an <iframe>, an .mp4 or .webm file a native <video>. Focus moves into the player. Use the privacy-friendly embed address where the service offers one (youtube-nocookie.com).

classes.name: v-video
classes.description: The link (and later the player's frame). Keeps --v-video-ratio (default 16 / 9). Always dark, like a player.

classes.name: v-video-play
classes.description: The overlay holding the button and the label.

classes.name: v-video-button
classes.description: The round play button around the play icon.

classes.name: v-video-label
classes.description: What the video is and how long, such as "Play: Product tour (2:14)". It names the link.

states.description: The video's own page, used without JS and for a new-tab click.
The player's title (the iframe's title attribute). Defaults to the link text.

hooks.name: data-v-video
hooks.description: On click, replaces the link with an iframe (embed URL) or a native video (file URL) and moves focus into it.

keyboard.action: On the poster, loads the player and moves focus into it.

a11y: The label inside the link names it ("Play: Product tour (2:14)"), so screen readers hear what will play; the poster image is decorative with alt="".
The iframe gets a title, which is how screen readers name an embedded player.
Focus moves into the player after the swap, so keyboard users do not have to find it again.

examples.title: Product tour
examples.description: Press play: a stand-in player page loads in place of the poster.
examples.html: Play: Northwind product tour (2:14)
